headline: Release truth now follows every critical route, validates its own score and provider scope, and welcomes visitors through a purpose-built IP doorway.

items.title: Critical-route promotion truth
items.insight: Production proof now watches the homepage, member portal, and Franchise Architect separately. A missing observation stays dark, while a slow first receipt gets time to settle before the second one can declare the deploy stranded.

items.title: Authorization-aware autonomy
items.insight: The priority engine can now tell founder-authorized identity migration from ordinary security work. It keeps the former visible but gated without using authorization language as an excuse to defer the latter.

items.title: Cloudflare bound-resource acceptance
items.insight: A valid token is no longer mistaken for a deploy-ready token. The live probe reached identity and Workers Scripts, then correctly stopped on the vaultspark-rum bucket’s HTTP 403 instead of launching a doomed deployment.

items.title: One canonical SIL truth
items.insight: The latest completed ledger entry now owns the session, total, and ten-category vector. Startup, project status, state vector, and integrity checks can no longer quietly disagree about the same score.

items.title: The Vault’s IP doorway
items.insight: The site gained a dedicated proprietary-rights page with its own voice, metadata, and place in the public map. Seven themes and mobile navigation all held their contrast and layout under staging inspection.
items.evidence: ip/index.html · sitemap.xml · Lighthouse 99/99/100/100 · seven-theme browser matrix

items.title: Universal-route sitemap enforcement
items.insight: Privacy, terms, contact, and IP are now checked as one universal route set from source file to sitemap membership. The Studio checker’s directory-index blind spot was also sent upstream with a reproducible Ark report.

items.title: Second-order work made reproducible
items.insight: The innovation pack is now a deterministic command and checked artifact instead of a disappearing brainstorm. Every candidate points back to code or evidence, which keeps overlap honest and future regeneration cheap.

followUps: After Cloudflare grants R2 Bucket Read/Edit for vaultspark-rum, rerun the bound-scope probe and capture the first successful Worker receipt.
If the founder authorizes Obelisk Phase-2, begin with callback-to-session behavioral proof before changing the active provider.
blockers: Cloudflare token reaches identity and Workers Scripts but receives HTTP 403 on the Worker-bound vaultspark-rum bucket.
Obelisk Phase-2 remains explicit-founder-authorization and relying-party-credential gated.

honestyLedger.title: No doomed Worker deploy
honestyLedger.why: The live resource-bound probe proved the R2 scope missing, so token identity was not promoted into a fabricated deploy-ready claim.

honestyLedger.title: No silent auth migration
honestyLedger.why: Supabase remains active and the Obelisk callback/session contract is incomplete; the authorization gate preserves that boundary.

honestyLedger.title: No one-sample strand alarm
honestyLedger.why: A single behind receipt is normal propagation evidence, not enough evidence to call production stranded.
